description: Live schema used by the Azure-hosted simulator to publish AGC replay telemetry plus player-controlled lunar-landing physics, controls, alarms, and outcomes to the Apollo11PlayableTelemetry Eventstream and directly to the Apollo11Eventhouse.AgcTelemetry table.

eventstream_source.name: ApolloTelemetrySource
eventstream_source.notes: The Azure Container App publishes directly with azure-eventhub. Its Event Hub-compatible connection string is stored only as a Container App secret.

columns.name: client_event_time
columns.description: Browser timestamp for playable lander messages

columns.name: mission_get
columns.description: Ground Elapsed Time HH:MM:SS

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Mission, alarm, game telemetry, control, touchdown, or crash event

columns.name: record_kind
columns.description: telemetry | mission_event | lander_game_telemetry | lander_game_event | lander_program_memory

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: Anonymous UUID persisted in this browser profile so multiple attempts can be grouped by player/device

columns.name: game_id
columns.description: UUID for one playable landing attempt; equal to attempt_id

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Landing attempt ID retained for compatibility with session-based queries

columns.name: attempt_id
columns.description: Client-generated landing attempt ID that survives transport reconnects

columns.name: scenario
columns.description: standard_lander or fabric_intervention

columns.name: incident_id
columns.description: UUID for one paused-flight Fabric intervention

columns.name: incident_state
columns.description: none, waiting, or resolved

columns.name: incident_wait_seconds
columns.description: Wall-clock time spent with flight physics frozen

columns.name: requires_fabric_action
columns.description: True while the paused flight is waiting for remediation

columns.name: recommended_dsky_command
columns.description: Fabric runbook command, populated only after the Operations Agent reaches recommendation_ready

columns.name: entered_dsky_command
columns.description: Completed command entered by the player on the incident DSKY

columns.name: dsky_command_status
columns.description: not_required, armed, entering, rejected, or accepted

columns.name: radio_altimeter_monitor_enabled
columns.description: False after V21 N68 parameter 0 is accepted

columns.name: memory_overflow
columns.description: True when memory reaches capacity

columns.name: operations_agent_state
columns.description: not_enabled, monitoring, investigating, recommendation_ready, or remediation_applied

columns.name: operations_agent_action
columns.description: Current detection, investigation, or remediation action

columns.name: operations_agent_confidence_pct
columns.description: Confidence in the Operations Agent diagnosis

columns.name: operations_agent_detection_id
columns.description: UUID correlating one Operations Agent investigation

columns.name: memory_sample_id
columns.description: UUID shared by the seven program-memory rows emitted for one game sample

columns.name: memory_pool_capacity_words
columns.description: Shared 2048-word memory-pool capacity

columns.name: memory_program_id
columns.description: Stable identifier for one of the seven running programs

columns.name: memory_program_name
columns.description: Display name of the program allocation

columns.name: memory_program_verb
columns.description: DSKY verb associated with the program

columns.name: memory_program_noun
columns.description: DSKY noun associated with the program

columns.name: memory_program_used_words
columns.description: Memory words allocated to this program

columns.name: memory_program_baseline_words
columns.description: Starting allocation for this program

columns.name: memory_program_growth_words_per_second
columns.description: Current allocation growth rate for this program

columns.name: memory_program_utilization_pct
columns.description: This program's share of the total memory pool

columns.name: memory_program_state
columns.description: stable, growing, overflow, or stopped

columns.name: connection_id
columns.description: Server-generated WebSocket connection ID

columns.name: message_id
columns.description: Idempotency ID for acknowledged one-shot game events

columns.name: program
columns.description: Active AGC program, e.g. P63/P64/P66

columns.name: code
columns.description: Alarm code such as 1202 or 1201, null otherwise

columns.name: core_sets_used
columns.description: Executive job-table (core set) utilization, 0-8

columns.name: radar_auto_slew
columns.description: True when the rendezvous radar is in AUTO/SLEW, injecting spurious jobs

columns.name: game_state
columns.description: ready | flying | incident | landed | crashed

columns.name: lander_x_m
columns.description: Horizontal position relative to the landing pad center

columns.name: lander_altitude_m
columns.description: Altitude of the landing legs above local terrain

columns.name: lander_vertical_speed_mps
columns.description: Positive values indicate descent
